ModMetaData.name: ProgressionLESS: Gravship
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Keeps the grav engine from falling until your colony reaches the Spacer era, and holds back the gravship quest line until then.
The "LESS" is less research: unlike recent versions of Progression: Gravship, it adds no extra research projects and doesn't rename or rearrange the gravtech research tree. Vanilla Gravship Expanded's research stays exactly as that mod made it.
Forked from Progression: Gravship by ferny. Replaces the original; do not use both.
